subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the runtime legacy no-code stale-diagnostic fallback, or should upgraded no-code cleanup move to doctor/migration before merge?
rationale: Repository policy treats persisted SQLite state and startup fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and the legacy branch intentionally broadens stale detection beyond the explicit new marker.

options.title: Require legacy upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Accept source and test proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the source proof and regression tests as enough, but that waives external real-behavior proof for upgraded persisted state.

options.title: Move cleanup out of runtime
options.body: Pause this PR and require the legacy no-code cleanup to be owned by doctor or migration code if runtime rederive is not the desired upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Require legacy upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the predecessor PR's explicit-marker direction and are the strongest recent owner signal for this plugin registry code.
